insights.one_liner: Norwegian farm machinery maker owned by Kubota, with Dutch sites in Nieuw-Vennep; a recognised sponsor, but its current finance role asks for Dutch.

culture.text: Develops and builds farm implements, electronics and digital farming services under the Kverneland, Vicon and Kubota brands.
Founded in 1879, headquartered in Stavanger, Norway, with about 1,104 people on LinkedIn, mostly in operations, sales and engineering.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Kverneland Group Europe, Kverneland Group Mechatronics B.V. and Kverneland Group Nieuw-Vennep B.V.
Its one current opening, a senior finance role in Nieuw-Vennep, asks for Dutch.

growth.text: Introduced a new mulcher, the Tersus 4000.

worth_knowing.text: Has been part of Japan's Kubota Group since 2012.
